name: hypit-md-to-pdf
description: Markdown → PDF via headless Chromium, with real @page margin-box headers/footers. Not part of the npm Distribution — see ../dub-server for the same convention.

scripts.build: node md-to-pdf.mjs ../../project.md ../../project.pdf --page-size a4 --title "热点驱动 · 多平台视频矩阵流水线" --author "设计目标" --cover --toc --header-text "追梦成真 ｜ AI视频智能生产解决方案专家" --footer-text "第 {page} 页 ｜ 热点驱动 · 多平台视频矩阵流水线 · 系统设计 V1.0"
